messages.content:
The snippets you posted don't show the root cause yet. They only confirm:


startProject.ts launches the dev server.


registry.ts only tracks runtime state and logs.


Neither file explains why AI Preview renders correctly while Designer and Dev show a white page.


Given the symptoms from the previous investigation:


AI Preview works.


Designer canvas is blank.


Dev canvas is blank.


Browser viewport values are abnormal:
JavaScriptinnerHeight: 359
outerHeight: 949
ratio: 2.64


This occurs only in certain panels.


That strongly suggests a frontend rendering/container issue, not runtime startup.
Before changing runtime code, inspect the actual browser DOM.
Open DevTools in the blank Designer page and run:
JavaScriptdocument.querySelector("#__next")?.getBoundingClientRect()
JavaScriptdocument.querySelector("main")?.getBoundingClientRect()
JavaScript[...document.querySelectorAll("iframe")].map(x => ({
  src: x.src,
  width: x.clientWidth,
  height: x.clientHeight,
  display: getComputedStyle(x).display,
  visibility: getComputedStyle(x).visibility,
  position: getComputedStyle(x).position
}))
JavaScriptdocument.body.innerHTML.includes("iframe")
Then inspect the React root:
JavaScriptdocument.querySelectorAll('[data-panel]')
JavaScript[...document.querySelectorAll('*')]
.filter(el => getComputedStyle(el).overflow === 'hidden')
.slice(0,50)
Also check whether the iframe itself is rendering:
JavaScriptconst f = document.querySelector("iframe");
f?.contentWindow?.location?.href
and
JavaScriptconst f = document.querySelector("iframe");
({
  rect: f?.getBoundingClientRect(),
  style: f ? getComputedStyle(f) : null
})
If AI Preview works while Designer and Dev don't, the most likely causes are:
Possibility A — iframe height collapse
Designer/Dev panel iframe height becomes 0px because of a flexbox/layout regression.
Typical symptom:
JavaScriptheight: 0
Possibility B — overlay covering iframe
An absolutely positioned overlay is sitting on top of the iframe.
Typical symptom:
JavaScriptdocument.elementFromPoint(
  window.innerWidth/2,
  window.innerHeight/2
)
returns some overlay div instead of iframe.
Possibility C — wrong preview URL
AI Preview points at:
http://localhost:<runtime-port>
Designer/Dev points at:
about:blank
or stale project URL.
Possibility D — zoom transform bug
The viewport values you reported earlier are unusual enough that a CSS transform or zoom calculation could be collapsing available height in only those panels.
Run:
JavaScriptgetComputedStyle(document.body).transform
JavaScriptgetComputedStyle(document.documentElement).transform
JavaScriptdocument.body.style.zoom
JavaScriptdocument.documentElement.style.zoom
Do not modify startProject.ts or registry.ts yet. The evidence still points toward the Designer/Dev UI layer rather than the runtime process layer.
Paste the results of the iframe inspection commands above. That will identify whether we're dealing with:


runtime failure,


iframe URL issue,


height collapse,


overlay obstruction,


or viewport scaling corruption.

The task is:
Fix KoreLumina preview/runtime behavior.
Current focus:


Preview frame layout bug

Right/bottom strip appears even when no iframe is rendered, so it’s likely in PreviewFrame wrapper layout.


Runtime stop/start bug

After stopping, the UI shows running/stale state or starts again incorrectly. Need to confirm whether backend auto-restart or frontend useRuntimeBoot() is responsible.


Preview not rebinding after stop/start

Runtime can be running on 4201, but PreviewFrame falls back to skeleton because runtimeUrl is cleared/not restored.


We should continue from the last concrete lead: inspect useRuntimeBoot.ts and runtime stop/start flow, not image generation.
How do I continue this conversation in a new window without breaking the flow?

Open a new chat and paste a handoff summary. Include:
PROJECT: KoreLumina

CURRENT ISSUE:
Preview/runtime system investigation.

FACTS VERIFIED:
- AI Preview renders correctly.
- Designer workspace blank/white.
- Developer workspace blank/white.
- PreviewFrame shows right and bottom strips even when no iframe is rendered.
- runtime:file-changed events are reaching the browser.
- SSE endpoint works.
- Runtime starts on port 4201.
- After Stop, preview skeleton appears.
- Runtime stop behavior still under investigation.
- localStorage.getItem("lumina:last-runtime-project") === null
- window.__LUMINA_RUNTIME__ === undefined

FILES UNDER INVESTIGATION:
- apps/lumina-builder/src/components/preview/PreviewFrame.tsx
- apps/lumina-builder/src/hooks/useRuntimeBoot.ts
- apps/lumina-runtime/src/runtime/startProject.ts
- apps/lumina-runtime/src/runtime/registry.ts

LAST CONCLUSION:
Do not investigate image generation, SVG errors, or React warnings.
Focus on:
1. PreviewFrame layout causing right/bottom strip.
2. useRuntimeBoot runtimeUrl lifecycle.
3. Runtime stop/start state synchronization.
4. Why AI Preview works while Designer and Developer previews do not.

NEXT STEP:
Audit PreviewFrame sizing chain and trace runtimeUrl from useRuntimeBoot into PreviewFrame after stop/start.
If you want the strongest continuity, also include the latest findings:
grep -R "runtime:file-changed" confirmed
curl -N http://localhost:4100/api/runtime/events confirmed
PreviewFrame contains:
- DEVICE_WIDTHS
- iframe
- place-items-center
- overflow-auto
- glass-strong container

Known symptom:
Runtime may be running, but PreviewFrame remains on skeleton and does not rebind.
That will give the new chat enough context to continue without redoing the investigation from scratch.
